definitions.meaning: a pledge or undertaking, especially to marry

parts.words: Stop in the name of the law
parts.note: a police officer's cry, also read as halting someone with legal authority

parts.note: pop suggests pop music, but means dad, so the festival is a celebration of fathers

clue.text: Not a direct form of slander

definitions.meaning: clothing, as a noun: what one wears
